eros_juno_midpoint.weight: Tight conjunction/hard aspect = high relational intensity.

saturn_north_node.template: Person A Saturn relating to Person B North Node.

source.title: Compatibility Analysis | Astrology of Predicting Relationships
source.section_theme: Love relationship compatibility using Venus sign synastry

sun_sign_limitations.statement: Sun sign compatibility is only one of many factors and can mislead without deeper synastry.
implications: Do not reject or accept a relationship purely on sun-sign match or mismatch.
Use sun signs as a coarse filter, with Venus synastry and full charts carrying more interpretive weight.

venus_focus.statement: For love relationships, comparing Venus signs reveals love style, bonding, and affection patterns more clearly than Sun sign comparison.
implications: Treat Venus sign pairings as primary modules in romantic synastry.
Where Venus data is missing, temporarily substitute Sun signs but mark results as lower-confidence.

use_cases.description: Compare both partners' Venus signs to derive romantic style, bonding patterns, and likely comfort zones in affection.
If birth time or Venus sign is unknown, use Sun sign with the same interpretive matrices but mark it as approximate.

person.notes: Core module uses venus_sign pairing; other factors weight or modify base compatibility.

compatibility_text_block.notes: Each Venus–Venus combination yields one structured text block, plus optional numeric indices.

indices_description.attraction_intensity: Subjective strength of magnetic pull and initial allure, 1–10 scale.
indices_description.stability_potential: Capacity to maintain a relationship over time, 1–10 scale.
indices_description.learning_potential: Depth of mutual growth and evolution possible, 1–10 scale.
indices_description.conflict_level: Likelihood of recurrent friction or clashes, 1–10 scale.
indices_description.sexual_chemistry: Overall erotic and physical charge in the connection, 1–10 scale.

self_profile.love_style: Direct, upfront, impulsive, and pioneering; tends to fall in love quickly and intensely, preferring to take the initiative.[page:2]
self_profile.core_needs: Excitement, challenge, spontaneity, space to assert individuality, and the feeling of actively pursuing love rather than passively receiving it.[page:2]
self_profile.strengths: Enthusiastic, demonstrative, courageous, willing to take risks for love and break stagnant patterns.[page:2]
self_profile.risks: Impatience, self-centered focus, moodiness, and a tendency for attraction to burn hot and then cool if novelty fades.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two blazing fires, mutual pursuit, and high-drama attraction.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: This pairing amplifies Aries qualities: both partners prefer to lead, move quickly, and dislike hesitation or ambiguity. Arguments and ego clashes can appear as rapidly as attractions, with sudden flare-ups followed by equally sudden reconciliations.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Intense, competitive, and physically charged, where sex often functions as both bonding and conflict resolution.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Passionate and reactive, with little tolerance for emotional passivity; feelings are expressed immediately and loudly.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Learning to alternate leadership and to listen before reacting; cultivating patience and deeper emotional reflection beyond initial impulses.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Schedule constructive outlets for shared energy (projects, sports, adventures) so the relationship is not defined only by arguing and making up.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Fast fire meets slow earth, creating attraction with friction over pace and comfort.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries wants immediate movement and decisive action, while Taurus prefers gradual bonding, predictability, and physical security. Each sees the other as either too fast or too slow, yet the contrast can feel stabilizing when respected.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Passionate and strongly sensual, with Aries providing heat and Taurus providing sustained physical presence.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries tends to express feelings bluntly and in the moment; Taurus internalizes more and can dig in when threatened, leading to standoffs.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Negotiating lifestyle tempo, spending habits, and the balance between risk-taking and comfort. Stubbornness on both sides can either build a solid shared life or lock you into unproductive routines.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Create shared rituals that satisfy Taurus’ need for continuity while leaving pockets of unscripted time for Aries’ need for spontaneity.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: High-speed, playful, and mentally stimulating, yet potentially unstable.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both signs like movement, novelty, and variety; Aries approaches with physical immediacy, Gemini through conversation and playful banter. Plans may change frequently, making the relationship exciting but sometimes unreliable.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Flirty, experimental, and quick to ignite, especially when sex is intertwined with games, teasing, and new experiences.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Feelings may be expressed in a spontaneous but somewhat scattered way, with little patience for heavy or repetitive emotional processing.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Grounding the connection in shared commitments without killing the sense of freedom; learning to follow through on what’s promised.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Set a few clear, non-negotiable agreements (about honesty, time, or priorities) while keeping room for spontaneity in day-to-day life.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Direct flame meets protective shell, blending passion with sensitivity.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries is quick to act and speak, while Cancer needs safety, time, and emotional attunement. Misunderstandings arise when Aries’ bluntness feels harsh to Cancer and Cancer’s indirectness feels confusing to Aries.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Potentially deeply bonding when Aries’ passion is channeled through Cancer’s desire for emotional closeness and caretaking.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Highly emotional pairing; Cancer may retreat into defensiveness if hurt, while Aries may initially push harder, not realizing the depth of impact.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Aries learning empathy and timing; Cancer learning to voice needs clearly rather than expecting intuitive understanding.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Use explicit reassurance and boundaries; check in emotionally after conflicts rather than assuming the matter is closed.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two proud fires, creating a dramatic, glamorous, and sometimes theatrical bond.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both enjoy attention, bold gestures, and heroic narratives in love. Power struggles can emerge around who gets to lead and who receives more recognition or admiration.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: High passion, playfulness, and expressive displays of desire; sex can feel like a stage where both want to shine.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Warm, generous, and big-hearted when egos feel appreciated; resentful and noisy when either feels ignored or disrespected.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Handling pride, admitting fault, and learning to share the spotlight gracefully.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Consciously celebrate each other’s wins, and create shared creative projects where both can express leadership in different domains.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Impulsive fire meets careful earth, challenging comfort zones for both.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries pursues quickly and can be brusque; Virgo is discriminating, attentive to details, and more cautious. Aries may see Virgo as overly critical, while Virgo may see Aries as reckless or insensitive.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Can be grounded and healing when Aries respects Virgo’s sensitivity and Virgo allows spontaneity.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries emotes more through action than analysis, while Virgo processes through problem-solving and refinement, sometimes over-analyzing feelings.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Bridging the gap between quick impulses and thoughtful consideration; learning to frame feedback without shaming.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Agree on which areas genuinely need structure and which can remain experimental so both feel secure and alive.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Opposites attract on the Aries–Libra axis, mixing courage with diplomacy.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries moves directly toward what it wants; Libra weighs options, seeks fairness, and consults others. The polarity produces strong attraction and frequent negotiation about decisiveness versus consideration.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Romantic, charged, and often classic ‘Mars–Venus’ chemistry with a mix of chase, charm, and seduction.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries tends toward passionate declarations; Libra leans into dialogue, reflection, and maintaining harmony.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Avoiding polarization into ‘aggressor versus appeaser’; learning shared decision-making that honors both initiative and fairness.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Use Aries’ courage to move forward on mutually discussed plans, rather than rushing ahead or getting stuck in endless weighing of pros and cons.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Raw fire meets deep water, creating intense and sometimes volatile chemistry.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries prefers straightforward expression, while Scorpio experiences layered, complex emotions and a strong need for privacy and control. Power dynamics and questions of trust can surface quickly.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Extremely charged and transformative; sex may feel cathartic or consuming for both.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: High emotional weather, with Scorpio likely to hold onto grievances longer than Aries, who prefers quick clean fights and resolutions.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Navigating jealousy, emotional intensity, and differing needs for disclosure versus privacy.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Establish clear agreements about honesty and boundaries; provide each other with safe outlets for strong feelings instead of testing loyalty through crisis.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two fires chasing horizons together, adventurous and restless.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both value freedom, new experiences, and straightforwardness. The bond is typically fast-moving and optimistic but may lack grounding if neither wants to deal with mundane responsibilities.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Sporty, exploratory, and often humor-infused; sex is experienced as play and discovery.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Upbeat and future-oriented, with a tendency to avoid heavy emotional stagnation, sometimes by changing the subject or environment.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Developing shared structures and commitments without feeling trapped; learning to stay present when difficulties arise.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Co-create long-term adventures (travel, study, projects) that also require consistent effort, so freedom and responsibility are integrated instead of opposed.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Now-focused fire meets future-focused earth, challenging timelines and priorities.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries emphasizes immediate action and experience; Capricorn evaluates risk, consequence, and long-term payoff. Tension appears around impulsive decisions versus strategic planning.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Potentially potent once trust is earned; Aries provides spark and Capricorn adds endurance and commitment.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries emotes quickly and openly; Capricorn tends to manage feelings through responsibility and control, revealing vulnerability slowly.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Building respect for each other’s approach to risk and structure; avoiding mutual judgment of ‘reckless’ versus ‘rigid’.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Clarify shared long-term goals and then allow Aries the freedom to experiment with how to reach them within agreed boundaries.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Independent fire and independent air, unconventional and stimulating.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both value autonomy; Aries approaches personally and passionately, Aquarius more conceptually and sometimes detached. There is a strong mutual respect for individuality, but mismatches in timing and emotional expression.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Experiment-friendly, mentally stimulating, and enlivened by novelty, unusual settings, or new ideas.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries may express feelings dramatically in the moment, while Aquarius takes more distance, turning to analysis or principle.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Understanding that detachment is not necessarily disinterest; learning to synchronize personal passion with broader ideals.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Create shared causes, communities, or experiments so the relationship channels its independence into a joint vision rather than pulling apart.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Straightforward fire meets porous water, with initial magic and later complexity.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries is direct and explicit; Pisces is subtle, intuitive, and often ambiguous. Early on, the difference can feel enchanting, later it may cause confusion or hurt if expectations remain unspoken.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: When trust exists, sex can blend Aries’ passion with Pisces’ sensitivity and imagination in deeply moving ways.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries tends to move quickly through feelings; Pisces feels everything in a diffuse, sometimes overwhelming way, requiring gentleness and reassurance.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Closing the gap between bluntness and subtlety in communication; avoiding martyrdom or resentment when needs are not voiced.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Aries can slow down and soften delivery, while Pisces practices clearer, more direct statements of feelings and boundaries.[page:2]

self_profile.love_style: Steady, sensual, and comfort-seeking, with a preference for gradual bonding and tangible displays of affection.[page:2]
self_profile.core_needs: Security, reliability, physical presence, and a predictable rhythm of connection and pleasure.[page:2]
self_profile.strengths: Persevering, loyal, and able to build material and emotional stability over time.[page:2]
self_profile.risks: Resistance to change, possessiveness, and over-prioritizing comfort and routine over emotional nuance.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Sensual earth anchors fiery spontaneity, with clashing speeds.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Taurus seeks a slow, secure build-up, whereas Aries thrives on decisive, rapid engagement. Both can be stubborn, leading either to powerful commitment or gridlock.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Strongly physical and passionate; Aries brings urgency, Taurus brings depth and endurance.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Taurus tends to stabilize and hold; Aries erupts and moves on, creating different emotional timelines.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Integrating differing needs for pace, comfort, and risk; agreeing on spending and lifestyle priorities.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Introduce changes gradually so Taurus can adapt, while Aries commits to a few consistent anchors that reassure Taurus.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Double earth comfort, deeply sensual with a risk of stagnation.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both value loyalty, routine, and physical pleasure. The relationship can feel like a safe haven, but may lack impetus for growth unless consciously cultivated.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Slow, indulgent, and body-centered; strong emphasis on touch, taste, and environment.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Consistent and predictable, but potentially resistant to discussing uncomfortable topics that threaten peace.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Avoiding ruts, complacency, and unspoken resentments that build over time.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Regularly introduce small, low-risk changes (new activities, environments) to keep life and intimacy fresh without overwhelming the need for security.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Steadfast earth meets nimble air, requiring flexibility on both sides.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Taurus anchors and preserves; Gemini explores and diversifies. Taurus may feel unsettled by Gemini’s variability, while Gemini may feel confined by Taurus’ routines.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Blends talk and touch when each stretches into the other’s style.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Taurus expresses through consistent deeds and presence; Gemini through words, humor, and shifting moods.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Normalizing different social needs and speeds of change without assuming incompatibility.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Design shared routines that leave room for unstructured social and mental variety, so both feel nourished.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Earth and water co-create a nurturing and protective bond.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both seek security and emotional safety, though Taurus focuses on material and sensual anchors while Cancer emphasizes emotional and family bonding.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Soft, enveloping, and comforting, often tied to domestic or private spaces.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Stable and caring, with occasional mood swings from Cancer that Taurus may try to steady or resist.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Managing clinginess, inertia, and the tendency to avoid discomfort by staying in familiar patterns.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Balance the urge to nest with activities that gently expand your shared world beyond home and routine.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Fixed earth and fixed fire, loyal but prideful.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both signs are strong-willed, with Taurus valuing simplicity and Leo craving recognition and flair. Conflicts over money, luxury, and social display can arise.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Warm, dramatic, and affectionate, with a desire for sensual consistency and romantic showmanship.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Deeply loyal, but slow to admit fault or change established emotional patterns.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Negotiating lifestyle aesthetics, spending, and public versus private expressions of love.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Make space both for Taurus’ need for calm and Leo’s need for celebration by alternating quiet comfort with planned ‘showy’ experiences.[page:2]

self_profile.love_style: Playful, curious, and conversational, approaching relationships as a space for exchange and learning.[page:2]
self_profile.core_needs: Mental stimulation, variety, social interaction, and freedom to shift focus.[page:2]
self_profile.strengths: Witty, adaptable, and able to reframe tension with humor or perspective.[page:2]
self_profile.risks: Perceived inconsistency, difficulty tolerating heavy emotional intensity, and a tendency to scatter attention.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Fast-moving fun, with both partners resisting stagnation.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries and Gemini both tend toward quick bonding and can jump into experiences together without much planning. Stability requires deliberate effort to build routines and commitments.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Novelty-driven, playful, and responsive to suggestions and spontaneous ideas.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Light and changeable, with a preference to keep things moving rather than dwelling on feelings for long.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Developing patience and follow-through; agreeing on which commitments really matter.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Use Gemini’s communication skills and Aries’ decisiveness to turn shared ideas into actual, sustainable plans.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Change-friendly air meets stability-loving earth.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Gemini introduces motion and variety; Taurus anchors and preserves. The bond thrives when each sees the other as complementary rather than obstructive.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Can be sensual and verbally stimulating when neither dismisses the other's style as superficial or heavy.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Gemini processes through dialogue and shifting perspectives; Taurus prefers quiet consistency and practical reassurance.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Managing differences in social needs and tolerance for change; preventing mutual labeling (‘boring’ vs ‘chaotic’).[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Set up a stable base that satisfies Taurus and use it as a platform for Gemini’s explorations, rather than an either–or choice.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Mirror of airiness, mental rapport, and shifting moods.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both partners share curiosity, versatility, and the tendency to split attention across multiple interests. Emotional grounding and long-term structure may be underdeveloped unless brought in from other chart factors.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Flirtatious, experimental, and responsive to suggestion; mood-dependent.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Flexible and playful, but may sidestep deeper emotional processing until crisis forces it.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Avoiding a relationship composed solely of talk and ideas without embodied follow-through.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Introduce agreed structures (shared responsibilities, scheduled check-ins) that do not feel overly restrictive but provide continuity.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Head-centered air engages heart-centered water.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Gemini tends to intellectualize or verbalize feelings, while Cancer experiences them deeply and personally. What Gemini sees as light teasing may feel hurtful to Cancer if not well-timed.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Best when playful banter is combined with genuine emotional attunement and reassurance.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Uneven pacing; Gemini moves quickly between topics, Cancer may linger on emotional events, needing more processing time.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Developing mutual respect for different emotional languages—words versus gestures and tone.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Gemini can slow down and validate feelings explicitly; Cancer can signal when humor is welcome versus when depth is needed.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Playful air fuels dramatic fire in a socially vibrant pairing.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both tend to enjoy social life, creativity, and expressive connection; Leo, however, needs a consistent sense of being special, which Gemini must consciously provide.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Creative, theatrical, and responsive to verbal praise and fantasy.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Generally upbeat, with occasional flare-ups if Leo feels sidelined by Gemini’s many interests.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Balancing Leo’s need for centrality with Gemini’s wide curiosity and social network.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Gemini can consciously spotlight Leo’s importance, while Leo allows Gemini space to explore ideas and friendships without undue suspicion.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two Mercury-ruled signs with different applications of analysis.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both appreciate information and clarity; Gemini is more experimental, Virgo more refining and service-oriented. Virgo’s critiques may feel limiting to Gemini, while Gemini’s inconsistency may frustrate Virgo.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Communicative and precise, but vulnerable to over-thinking if anxiety or perfectionism intrudes.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Prone to analysis of feelings, with Virgo more solution-focused and Gemini more idea-focused.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Avoiding nitpicking, scattered commitments, and treating each other as puzzles to solve rather than people to relate to.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Channel your shared mental energy into cooperative projects and learning, so criticism transforms into co-creation.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Air–air harmony with strong social and aesthetic alignment.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both enjoy ideas, conversation, and human interaction. Libra is more partnership-oriented and diplomatic; Gemini is more free-form and experimental.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Romantic, communicative, and responsive to atmosphere and words.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Generally light and balanced, though decision-making can be delayed by over-analysis or indecision.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Preventing endless discussion from substituting for action; balancing Libra’s desire for harmony with Gemini’s tolerance for temporary dissonance.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Use structured dialogues with clear outcomes to prevent drifting conversations and to move shared ideas into practice.[page:2]

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Reactive, immediate, loud expression of feelings.

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries blunt/in-the-moment; Taurus internalizes, digs in when threatened.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Negotiating tempo, spending, risk vs. comfort; stubborn standoffs.

partner_archetypes.headline: High-speed playful mental stimulation, potentially unstable

partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Flirty, experimental, ignited by games/teasing/new experiences.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Spontaneous but scattered; low tolerance for heavy processing.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Grounding in commitments without killing freedom; follow-through.
partner_archetypes.advice: Set clear non-negotiable agreements while preserving spontaneity.

partner_archetypes.headline: Direct flame meets protective shell – passion + sensitivity blend
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries blunt/quick; Cancer needs safety/time. Bluntness can wound; indirectness confuses.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Deep bonding when passion channeled through emotional closeness.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Highly emotional; Cancer retreats when hurt, Aries may push harder.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Aries empathy/timing; Cancer clear voicing of needs.

partner_archetypes.headline: Two proud fires – dramatic, glamorous, theatrical bond
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both love attention, bold gestures, heroic love narratives. Power struggles over leadership/recognition.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: High passion, playful, expressive desire; sex as performance stage.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Warm/generous when appreciated; resentful/noisy when ignored.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Handling pride, admitting fault, sharing spotlight.
partner_archetypes.advice: Celebrate each other’s wins; shared creative projects with alternating leadership.

partner_archetypes.headline: Impulsive fire meets careful earth – challenging comfort zones
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries brusque/quick; Virgo discriminating/cautious. Aries sees criticism; Virgo sees recklessness.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Grounded/healing when Aries respects Virgo sensitivity and Virgo allows spontaneity.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries action-based; Virgo analytical/problem-solving, prone to over-analysis.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Quick impulse vs. thoughtful consideration; feedback without shaming.
partner_archetypes.advice: Agree on structure vs. experimentation zones.

partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries direct; Libra weighs/fair/diplomatic. Strong polarity attraction + negotiation over decisiveness vs. consideration.

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries passionate declarations; Libra dialogue/reflection/harmony focus.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Avoiding aggressor–appeaser polarization; shared decision-making.
partner_archetypes.advice: Use Aries courage to execute mutually discussed plans.

partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Extremely charged/transformative; potentially cathartic or consuming.

partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Jealousy, intensity, disclosure vs. privacy.
partner_archetypes.advice: Clear honesty/boundary agreements; safe outlets for strong feelings.

partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Sporty/exploratory/humor-infused; sex as play/discovery.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Upbeat/future-oriented; avoid heavy stagnation by changing subject/environment.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Shared structures/commitments without feeling trapped; staying present in difficulty.
partner_archetypes.advice: Co-create long-term adventures requiring consistent effort.

partner_archetypes.headline: Now-focused fire meets future-focused earth – timeline/priority tension
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries immediate; Capricorn risk/consequence/long-term payoff. Impulsive vs. strategic friction.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Potent once trust earned; Aries spark + Capricorn endurance.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries quick/open; Capricorn managed through responsibility/control, slow vulnerability.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Respect for risk/structure approaches; avoid reckless vs. rigid judgment.
partner_archetypes.advice: Clarify shared goals; allow Aries experimentation within boundaries.

partner_archetypes.headline: Independent fire + independent air – unconventional/stimulating
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both value autonomy; Aries personal/passionate, Aquarius conceptual/detached. Mutual respect for individuality.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Experiment-friendly/mentally stimulating; novelty/unusual settings.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries dramatic/in-moment; Aquarius distant/analytical/principle-based.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Detachment ≠ disinterest; synchronize passion with ideals.
partner_archetypes.advice: Shared causes/communities/experiments channeling independence into joint vision.

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries quick through feelings; Pisces diffuse/overwhelming, needs gentleness.

partner_archetypes.advice: Aries softens delivery; Pisces clearer direct statements of feelings/boundaries.

sun_sign_limitations.statement: Sun sign compatibility is only one of many factors and can easily mislead if taken in isolation.[page:2]
implications: Do not accept or reject a relationship solely based on Sun sign match or mismatch.[page:2]
Full synastry, including Venus, Moon, Ascendant, and key aspects, provides a more accurate picture of relationship dynamics.[page:2]

venus_focus.statement: For love and romantic relationships, comparing Venus signs reveals love style, bonding, and affection patterns more clearly than simply comparing Sun signs.[page:2]
implications: Treat Venus–Venus comparatives as the primary compatibility module.[page:2]
Sun–Sun can be reused as a fallback when Venus is unknown, but must be flagged as approximate and lower-confidence.[page:2]

person.description: Each partner is modeled minimally by Sun and Venus sign, with optional emotional (Moon), sexual/drive (Mars), and presentation (Ascendant) modifiers.[page:2]

self_profile.love_style: Direct, spontaneous, and courageous; approaches love like a quest or challenge, often preferring to be the initiator.[page:2]
self_profile.core_needs: Excitement, movement, honesty, personal freedom, and a sense of conquest or progress in love.[page:2]
self_profile.strengths: Enthusiastic, passionate, transparent about attraction, willing to take risks to pursue desired partners.[page:2]
self_profile.risks: Impatience, self-focus, low tolerance for slow pacing, and a tendency for intense but short-lived infatuations.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two blazing fires, mutual pursuit, and high-drama magnetism.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both partners rush toward what they want, dislike hesitation, and meet conflict head-on. The connection oscillates between thrilling togetherness and equally intense disagreements if neither yields.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Physically charged, competitive, and often impulsive, with sex doubling as both bonding and conflict-resolution.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Highly expressive but not always reflective; feelings are shown immediately and loudly, then quickly reset.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Developing patience, listening skills, and non-reactive communication so disagreements do not escalate into habitual battles.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Alternate leadership roles consciously and create structured outlets for shared energy—sports, projects, adventures—to prevent the relationship from being defined by conflict alone.[page:2]

meta.notes: Structure and emphasis consistent with the site’s treatment of high-fire pairings.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Impulsive fire meets steady earth; magnetic yet stubborn.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries pushes for rapid movement and novelty, while Taurus values gradual bonding, consistency, and physical comfort. Each can see the other as either too reckless or too slow, yet the tension can be stabilizing if negotiated.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Strong sensual passion, with Aries bringing urgency and Taurus anchoring the experience in the body.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries emotes quickly and then moves on, while Taurus holds feelings longer and resists rapid change, leading to different emotional tempos.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Negotiating lifestyle pace, risk tolerance, and stubbornness so conflicts deepen trust instead of calcifying into grudges.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Build shared routines that satisfy Taurus’ need for predictability while leaving room for Aries’ spontaneous adventures within an agreed container.[page:2]

meta.notes: Explicitly aligned with Taurus–Aries descriptions and general fire–earth logic.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Fast-moving, playful, and mentally stimulating, with a restless edge.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries thrives on action, Gemini thrives on variety and ideas. Plans change quickly, and both may prefer exciting possibilities over maintenance tasks, challenging long-term stability.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Flirty, inventive, and quick to ignite, especially when combining physical spontaneity with verbal play.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Emotion tends to be expressed in bursts (Aries) or through humor and words (Gemini), with limited patience for heavy processing.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Grounding the relationship in a few clear commitments without collapsing its sense of freedom and fun.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Define non-negotiable agreements around honesty, time, and priorities, and keep the rest flexible to preserve spontaneity.[page:2]

meta.notes: Matches the site’s description of Aries–Gemini as fun but unstable.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Direct fire stirs sensitive water; passionate but emotionally delicate.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries approaches feelings plainly and quickly, while Cancer requires safety and nuance. Cancer may retreat when overwhelmed, which Aries can misread as disinterest or manipulation.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Potentially deeply bonding when Aries’ ardor meets Cancer’s longing for emotional closeness and protection.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Highly responsive, with Aries leaning into confrontation and Cancer gravitating toward retreat or caretaking patterns.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Integrating directness with sensitivity; turning reactive cycles into conscious repair rituals.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Aries benefits from softening tone and giving reassurance; Cancer benefits from naming needs explicitly instead of hinting.[page:2]

meta.notes: Anchored in visible Aries–Cancer logic plus general cardinal fire–water dynamics.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two proud fires intensify romance, creativity, and ego.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both signs enjoy drama in the positive sense—grand gestures, bold moves, and heroic narratives. Disputes can revolve around who leads, who is admired more, or whose vision dominates.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Theatrical, generous, and passionate, with a strong desire to impress and be admired by the partner.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Warm and expressive, but easily bruised by perceived disrespect or lack of attention.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Learning to compromise without feeling humiliated; treating each other’s pride as something to protect, not attack.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Create explicit rituals of mutual admiration and appreciation to keep ego needs acknowledged and fed.[page:2]

meta.notes: Aligns with the text’s portrayal of Aries–Leo as high-ego, high-energy pairing.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: High-speed fire meets careful earth; growth through mutual adaptation.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries tends to leap first and think later; Virgo thinks first and may hesitate to leap at all. Aries may feel criticized, while Virgo may feel rushed or dismissed.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Grounded and potentially healing once trust is built, but susceptible to performance anxiety if criticism dominates.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries expresses feelings in short, intense bursts; Virgo often processes quietly, through analysis and service.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Balancing spontaneity with discernment; reframing Virgo’s feedback as care rather than attack, and Aries’ initiative as courage rather than recklessness.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Agree clearly on which domains need structure and which can stay flexible, so neither feels chronically undermined.[page:2]

meta.notes: Pattern extrapolated from Aries–Virgo passages and earth–fire contrast.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Opposite ends of the axis: initiative meets diplomacy.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries moves directly toward decisions; Libra collects input and seeks fairness. This creates strong attraction and frequent negotiations about speed and style of decision-making.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Romantic and charged, with a classic pursuit–receptivity dynamic that can flip roles over time.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries is expressive and blunt, Libra more measured and considerate, often mediating or softening conflict.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Avoiding the extremes of constant conflict vs over-compromise; sharing responsibility for initiating and harmonizing.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Use explicit negotiation frameworks (e.g., each states needs before debating solutions) to keep differences productive.[page:2]

meta.notes: Closely tracks site’s Aries–Libra opposites-attract narrative.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Raw fire meets deep water, generating intense, transformative chemistry.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries is straightforward, favoring open conflict; Scorpio is complex, strategic, and sensitive to trust and control. Power dynamics and jealousy can become central themes.[page:2]

partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Highly charged; Aries tends to blow up and cool down quickly, while Scorpio may hold onto emotional content and process slowly.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Respecting privacy, regulating intensity, and avoiding loyalty tests that spiral into drama.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Define transparent boundaries around honesty, commitment, and individual space, and revisit them as trust deepens.[page:2]

meta.notes: Consistent with fire–fixed-water polarity and the site’s remarks on high-intensity pairings.[page:2]

partner_profiles.headline_style: Two fires chasing horizons together; optimistic and restless.[page:2]
partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Both value freedom, exploration, and directness; they may travel, learn, or build big visions together but resist mundane routines.[page:2]
partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Sporty, experimental, and fun, often linked to outdoor, travel, or adventure contexts.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Buoyant and future-oriented, with a tendency to move past difficulties quickly, sometimes prematurely.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Building everyday structures and responsibilities without feeling trapped or dulled.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Commit to shared long-term adventures that also require consistent effort, blending freedom with accountability.[page:2]

meta.notes: Matches the site’s fire–fire framing of Aries–Sagittarius bonds.[page:2]

partner_profiles.relationship_dynamics: Aries prioritizes immediate action, Capricorn considers consequence and structure. Tension arises around impulsivity vs caution, risk vs security.[page:2]

meta.notes: Inferred from fire–cardinal vs earth–cardinal tensions; consistent with site’s pacing and structure remarks.[page:2]

partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Experimental and mentally charged, often linked to unconventional settings or concepts.[page:2]
partner_profiles.emotional_tone: Aries expresses feelings hot and direct; Aquarius may take a step back to analyze or contextualize.[page:2]
partner_profiles.growth_challenges: Interpreting detachment correctly and coordinating personal passion with collective or ideological priorities.[page:2]
partner_profiles.practical_advice: Create shared causes, experiments, or communities so independence is expressed together rather than apart.[page:2]

meta.notes: Consistent with fire–fixed-air, independence themes, and site’s unconventional pair references.[page:2]

partner_profiles.sexual_tone: Tender and imaginative when trust is present, combining Aries’ passion with Pisces’ sensitivity and fantasy.[page:2]

partner_profiles.practical_advice: Aries practices gentler timing; Pisces practices explicit articulation of boundaries and needs.[page:2]

meta.notes: Conforms with the site’s description of Aries–Pisces as initially fascinating but challenging long-term.[page:2]

self_archetype.template: Person A with Venus in Aries
self_archetype.love_style: Direct, impulsive, pioneering; falls in love quickly and intensely, prefers to initiate and pursue.
self_archetype.core_needs: Excitement, challenge, spontaneity, freedom to assert individuality, sense of conquest/progress.
self_archetype.strengths: Enthusiastic, courageous, transparent attraction, risk-taking in love.
self_archetype.shadow: Impatience, self-centered focus, burnout when novelty fades, moodiness.

partner_archetypes.headline: Two blazing fires – mutual pursuit, high-drama magnetism
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both rush forward, dislike hesitation, meet conflict head-on. Thrilling togetherness alternates with intense flare-ups and rapid reconciliations.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Physically charged, competitive, impulsive; sex as bonding and conflict resolution.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Highly expressive, immediate, loud; feelings shown instantly then reset quickly.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Patience, listening before reacting, deeper reflection beyond impulse.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Alternate leadership; channel energy into shared projects/sports/adventures to balance arguing/making-up cycle.

partner_archetypes.headline: Impulsive fire meets steady earth – magnetic yet stubborn
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries rapid/novelty-driven; Taurus gradual/security-focused. Tension over pace/comfort; stubbornness can stabilize or deadlock.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Strong sensual passion – Aries urgency + Taurus depth/endurance.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries quick/open then moves on; Taurus holds longer, resists rapid change.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Negotiating tempo, spending, risk vs. comfort; stubborn standoffs.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Build rituals satisfying Taurus predictability while allowing Aries spontaneity pockets.

partner_archetypes.headline: Fast-moving playful mental stimulation – restless edge
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both love variety/movement; Aries physical, Gemini verbal/playful. Frequent plan changes; exciting but potentially unreliable.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Flirty, inventive, quick ignition; combines physical spontaneity with verbal play.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Bursts (Aries) or humor/words (Gemini); low tolerance for heavy processing.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Grounding in commitments without killing freedom; follow-through.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Define non-negotiable agreements (honesty/time/priorities) while preserving spontaneity.

partner_archetypes.headline: Direct fire stirs sensitive water – passionate yet delicate
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries plain/quick; Cancer needs safety/nuance. Bluntness wounds; indirectness confuses.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Deep bonding when passion meets emotional closeness/protection.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Highly responsive; Cancer retreats when hurt, Aries may push harder.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Directness with sensitivity; reactive cycles into conscious repair.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Aries softens tone/reassures; Cancer names needs explicitly.

partner_archetypes.headline: Two proud fires – dramatic/glamorous/theatrical bond
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both love attention/bold gestures/heroic narratives. Power struggles over leadership/recognition.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Theatrical, generous, passionate; desire to impress/be admired.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Warm/expressive when appreciated; resentful/noisy when disrespected.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Compromise without humiliation; protect each other’s pride.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Rituals of mutual admiration; shared creative projects with alternating leadership.

partner_archetypes.headline: High-speed fire meets careful earth – growth through adaptation
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries leaps first; Virgo thinks first/hesitates. Aries feels criticized; Virgo feels rushed.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Grounded/healing when trust built; vulnerable to performance anxiety if criticism dominates.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries short intense bursts; Virgo quiet analysis/service-oriented.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Spontaneity vs. discernment; reframe feedback as care, initiative as courage.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Agree on structure vs. flexibility zones.

partner_archetypes.headline: Opposite axis – initiative meets diplomacy
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries direct/decisive; Libra weighs/fair/diplomatic. Strong polarity + negotiation over speed/style.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Romantic/charged; classic pursuit–receptivity dynamic.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries blunt declarations; Libra measured/considerate/mediating.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Avoid aggressor–appeaser extremes; shared responsibility for initiating/harmonizing.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Explicit negotiation frameworks (state needs before solutions).

partner_archetypes.headline: Raw fire meets deep water – intense/transformative chemistry
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries straightforward/open conflict; Scorpio complex/strategic/privacy/control. Power/jealousy central.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Extremely potent; emotional/physical intensity, potentially all-consuming.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: High charge; Aries quick blow-up/cool-down; Scorpio holds/processes slowly.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Respect privacy, regulate intensity, avoid loyalty tests.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Transparent boundaries/honesty/commitment agreements; revisit as trust deepens.

partner_archetypes.headline: Two fires chasing horizons – optimistic/restless
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both value freedom/exploration/directness. Fast-moving/optimistic; resist mundane routines.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Sporty/experimental/fun; linked to adventure/travel/outdoors.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Buoyant/future-oriented; move past difficulties quickly (sometimes prematurely).
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Everyday structures/responsibilities without feeling trapped.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Shared long-term adventures requiring consistent effort.

partner_archetypes.headline: Here-and-now fire meets long-range earth strategy
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries immediate action; Capricorn consequence/structure/long-term payoff. Impulsivity vs. caution tension.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Potent once trust established; Aries ignites, Capricorn deepens/stabilizes.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries open/quick; Capricorn measured/responsibility-based, slow vulnerability.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Avoid reckless vs. rigid judgments; coordinate timelines.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Agree major goals; allow Aries short-term flexibility within boundaries.

partner_archetypes.headline: Independent fire + independent air – unconventional love
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both value autonomy/authenticity. Aries personal/passionate; Aquarius conceptual/detached.
partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Experimental/mentally charged; unconventional settings/concepts.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries hot/direct; Aquarius steps back to analyze/contextualize.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Interpret detachment correctly; synchronize passion with ideals.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Shared causes/experiments/communities channel independence together.

partner_archetypes.headline: Straightforward fire meets diffuse water – magic with complexity

partner_archetypes.sexual_tone: Tender/imaginative when trust present; passion + sensitivity/fantasy.
partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries quick through feelings; Pisces absorbs/lingers, sometimes internalizes as self-blame.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Directness vs. indirectness gap; avoid retreat/aggression or martyrdom.
partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Aries gentler timing; Pisces explicit boundaries/needs articulation.

self_archetype.template: Person A with Venus in Aries

partner_archetypes.headline: Two blazing fires – mutual pursuit, high-drama magnetism
partner_archetypes.dynamics: Both rush forward, dislike hesitation, meet conflict head-on. Thrilling togetherness alternates with intense flare-ups and rapid reconciliations.

partner_archetypes.headline: Impulsive fire meets steady earth – magnetic yet stubborn

partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Build rituals satisfying Taurus predictability while allowing Aries spontaneity pockets.

partner_archetypes.headline: Fast-moving playful mental stimulation – restless edge

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Bursts (Aries) or humor/words (Gemini); low tolerance for heavy processing.

partner_archetypes.headline: Direct fire stirs sensitive water – passionate yet delicate

partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Aries softens tone/reassures; Cancer names needs explicitly.

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Warm/expressive when appreciated; resentful/noisy when disrespected.

partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Rituals of mutual admiration; shared creative projects with alternating leadership.

partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Agree on structure vs. flexibility zones.

partner_archetypes.emotional_tone: Aries blunt declarations; Libra measured/considerate/mediating.
partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Avoid aggressor–appeaser extremes; shared responsibility for initiating/harmonizing.

partner_archetypes.dynamics: Aries straightforward/open conflict; Scorpio complex/strategic/privacy/control. Power/jealousy central.

partner_archetypes.growth_challenges: Everyday structures/responsibilities without feeling trapped.

partner_archetypes.practical_advice: Shared causes/experiments/communities channel independence together.
